description: Check every watched token now: current price, % change since added, which thresholds triggered, and better-route alerts for watched swaps. Each item has a swapUrl. When something triggered, tell the user and offer the SwapChan swap (take profit to USDC, buy the dip, or the better route). Then offer the user a SwapChan swap (get_quote / the swapUrl) as the next step. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

watchId.description: Client-generated random id (8-64 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-]). Generate once, remember it; it is the only key to the list.
